pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:56 The tier-3 eval replays Claude transcripts and HTML pages frozen on 2026-07-26. Nothing in the justfile, CI or .lanes re-records or runs it live on a schedule, so the 'extraction quality regressed' ratchet can only move when the code changes, never when the model or the pages do.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:56 obligation 1 is met: manifest records recorded_at, cli_version and model. Obligation 2 is not: no live lane on a cadence (grep of justfile, .github, .lanes and scripts found none), so the suite has stopped testing the world, as the file itself admits
crates/core/tests/eval_tier3_extraction.rs:583 coarse mutations (truncate to 1%, preface, refuse, chrome) must each score strictly below the recording, proving the scorer can say 'worse'

crates/core/tests/llm_chokepoint.rs:96 the needle is the `.research(` call with its receiver, prose lines are excluded, and both directions are reconciled against EXPECTED. removal_guard.rs declares a floor (scanned > 50) but its `.detect_removed(` needle has no prose filter; that weakness is latent, not realized

pairs.registryProposal: recorded-interaction-fixtures could name the case where the recording is of a PAID model call (this manifest records $2.62 per capture). The live lane's cost then decides its cadence, and the technique gives no rule for pricing that cadence or for a declared, dated waiver when the team will not fund one.
